t: What he asked for on the road besides safety
a: أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الأَرْضِ
p: Asʾaluka fī safarī hādhā mina-l-birri wa-t-taqwā wa mina-l-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā-l-masīra wa-ṭwi ʿannā buʿda-l-arḍ
m: I ask You on this journey of mine for goodness and mindfulness, and for the deeds that please You. O Allah, make the going easy on us and fold up the distance of the earth for us.
